'''ar2dee2 Smuggling hidden sandcrabs and operatives:''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[ar2dee2]]
* '''Published:''' 5 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 HB ar2dee2 LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

My pride and joy: The best and latest version of sandcrabs! Good hiding and draining!

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Mega Mega Instructions!
U know how this works. use Kirdo III’s game text to get out sandwhirls and deserts for speeder and operative protection. get out 7 planets no one knows which planet to pick....
Anything else d-mail me!

Thanks,


Mark Zoran
BKA: Count Bunkula.
